No, I can't promise that. Albert doesn't guarantee a specific amount at sign-up. Any cash advance or offer depends on things like your eligibility, linked bank account activity, and income history, so the amount you're approved for may be lower than what you've seen advertised.

If you saw a $1,000 figure in an ad or promotion, check its terms and eligibility requirements. After you sign up and link your account, the app will show the exact amount you qualify for before you commit to anything.
